title: Login with valid standard_user credentials
expected: User lands on /inventory and the Products heading is visible

title: Login fails with an incorrect password
expected: Error alert reads 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service' and the URL stays on the login page

title: Login fails with an empty username
expected: Error alert reads 'Epic sadface: Username is required'

title: Login fails with an empty password
expected: Error alert reads 'Epic sadface: Password is required'

title: locked_out_user cannot log in
expected: Error alert reads 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.' and no navigation occurs

title: Password field masks the typed value
steps: Type tta_secret into the password field
expected: The password input has type=password and no value attribute is serialised into the markup

title: Login page does not echo credentials in an error message
steps: Submit the login form with a wrong password
expected: The error message names no username or password value

title: Inventory page lists exactly six products after login
expected: Exactly 6 product articles render, each with a name, price and Add to cart button

title: Sort products by price low to high
steps: Choose 'Price (low to high)' in the Sort products dropdown
Read the prices top to bottom
expected: Prices ascend, starting at $7.99 (TTA Junior Tester Onesie)

title: Add the first product to the cart updates the badge
steps: Click Add to cart on Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red)
Read the cart badge in the header
expected: The cart badge shows 1

title: Remove an item from the cart clears the badge
steps: Add any product to the cart
expected: The item disappears from the cart and the header badge is no longer shown

title: Cart shows the correct item, quantity and price
steps: Add Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) to the cart
expected: The cart lists the T-shirt with QTY 1 and price $15.99

title: Checkout is blocked when the first name is empty
steps: Add a product and click Checkout
Leave First Name blank, fill Last Name and Zip
expected: Error reads 'Error: First Name is required' and the user stays on checkout-step-one

title: Checkout is blocked when the postal code is empty
steps: Add a product and click Checkout
Fill First and Last Name, leave Zip/Postal Code blank
expected: Error reads 'Error: Postal Code is required' and no navigation to checkout-step-two occurs

title: Checkout overview totals add up correctly
steps: Read the Price Total block on checkout-step-two
expected: Item total $15.99 plus Tax $1.28 equals Total $17.27 (8% tax)

title: Completing checkout shows the thank-you confirmation
steps: Complete checkout step one and step two
expected: URL ends in /checkout-complete and the heading 'Thank you for your order!' is visible

title: Cancel on the checkout overview returns to the cart
expected: The user returns to the cart page with the item still present

title: Direct navigation to checkout-complete without an order
steps: Navigate straight to /checkout-complete without placing an order
expected: The user should be redirected to the cart or inventory; currently the thank-you page renders regardless (known defect)

title: Logout from the hamburger menu ends the session
expected: The user returns to the login page and cannot reach /inventory by going back

title: SSO and Passkey sign-in options are not present on the login page
steps: Look for 'Sign in using SSO' and 'Sign in with Passkey' buttons
expected: Both buttons should be visible below 'Sign in with Google'; neither exists today, so this fails (tracked against the auth enhancements epic)
